title: 3 Tips to Start Executing a Career Pivot ✍️
description:
If you’re thinking about a career pivot how can you use all your work histroy and current experience to effecitvely and honestly position yourself. This is a big topic so let us know if you’d like to see more but the first 3 things to think about is 1) Staying honest. 2) Not using “aspiring” 3) Utilizing transferrable skills on your LinkedIn and your resume. #careerpath #careerpivot #careeradvice
